name: Waveshare RP2040-Zero
description: Postage-stamp RP2040 board (23.5 x 18 mm) with USB-C, 2 MB flash, WS2812 LED and castellated edges for under $4; 20 edge GPIOs plus 9 more on pads.
notes: Only 20 GPIOs (GP0-15, GP26-29) are on the castellated edge; GP17-GP25 are underside solder pads. GP16 drives the WS2812 RGB LED.
BOOT and RESET buttons give UF2 drag-and-drop programming. No SWD header.
Sold without headers ($3.99); a pre-soldered version is about $1 more. Header geometry taken from the Waveshare size drawing (2.54 mm castellated U-shape, rows 15.24 mm apart).
